query: Ung thư bạch cầu cấp dòng lympho (ALL) ở trẻ em là gì và nguyên nhân gây bệnh thường gặp là gì?

history.llm:
The provided texts are about Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL), a type of cancer that affects the blood and bone marrow. It is the most common type of leukemia in children under 15 years old, accounting for about 75% of all leukemias in this age group.

The texts discuss various aspects of ALL, including its causes, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment. Some texts focus on the role of genetic mutations (biological changes passed from parent to offspring) in the development of ALL, while others discuss the differences between ALL in children and adults.

One text mentions that ALL can be divided into two main types: T-ALL (T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia) and B-ALL (B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia), based on the type of immune cells affected.

Another text discusses the symptoms of ALL, which can include fatigue, frequent infections, swollen lymph nodes, and easy bruising or bleeding. The text also mentions that a high white blood cell count (more than 50 G/L) is often a sign of a poor prognosis for treatment.

Overall, the texts provide information about the causes, symptoms, and treatment options for ALL, as well as some of the current research being conducted in this field.
